description: Declares the ACLs bug-reports needs on its collaborative folders. Read by install-collection Step 5.5 and provisioned via the permission-change-helper skill (admin reviews + Accepts). Never applied by aifs_share directly. {param} placeholders are resolved at provisioning time from collection-setup-responses.md and org-config.json.

acls.rationale: Every member files bugs into bugs/ via report-bug. Unique-by-construction filenames mean no write contention. Additive grant on top of the parent all@ reader; new bug files inherit it.

Detach config/ from the broad /shared all@ reader inheritance so the log-server auth key (config/auth-key.txt) is NOT member-readable. inherit:false applied directly on config/ (requires organizer/owner; admin has it). Admin retains access via ownership; forward-bug (admin-only) still reads the key. Requires permission-helper-go >= 0.3.0.
